prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: Two thousand dollars are (A) / a highly reasonable price to pay (B) / for this customized high-end industrial server workstation. (C) / No Error (D)
options: a highly reasonable price to pay
for this customized high-end industrial server workstation.
explanation: A sum of money treated as a single amount takes a singular verb, so 'Two thousand dollars are' should be 'Two thousand dollars is'.
